A '''galven pattern damping sleeve''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. It was used to allow a blaster to generate a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting.<ref name="CRFG" /> [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] was fitted with a galven pattern dampen sleeve.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
